what: The character art in the middle of the screen pops up from .75 scale and 45px below with .65s back.out(1.8) and wiggles its hips every 120ms through centre·right·centre·left frames (data-frame). When the cursor passes gently over the art it is pushed by .45 times the distance moved (up to ±160px) and returns with .5s power2.out. When struck hard (2px/ms or more · over 20px) it flies to the 340px wall on that side in .22s power2.out and tilts 12° (the moment it passes 160px, a look-back frame turn), and beside the wall a speech bubble enters from 25px outside at .85 scale·±4° in .28s. Then it bounces back to centre with .65s elastic.out(1, .45), and from the art centre a 900px circle in the next background colour spreads to the screen corners in .85s power2.out and becomes the background, while the speech bubble switches off in .35s after .18s. After staying turned back for .25s it changes into the next outfit (hat colour) and wiggles again. After a hit, the cursor must leave the art once before it can hit again

options.colors: Background color list — space-separated css variable names (--site-hue-0 --site-hue-1 …). One is picked at random on open, and the next one on each paint
options.prop: Name of the document variable that receives the background color, default --fx-page — the consuming side uses background: var(--fx-page, var(--kf-bg))
options.costumes: Costume color table (css variable names) — put into the artwork as --fx-costume. The consumer uses var(--fx-costume, …) for the hat fill
options.wall · gentle · push: Fly-away distance (px) · max distance on a gentle push (px) · push multiplier, default 340 · 160 · .45
options.speed · min: Speed (px/ms) and distance (px) counted as a hard hit, default 2 · 20
options.turn: Distance (px) to switch to the looked-back frame, default 160
options.fly · back · hold · ripple: Fly-away, return, stay looking back, and bleed durations (seconds), default .22 · .65 · .25 · .85
options.frames: Shake frame interval (ms), default 120 — 0 means no shaking
options.side-gap · bubble-y · bubble-top: Speech bubble position (px from center · px up from 55% of the screen) · shown only below this scroll position (px, -1 means always), default 260 · 170 · 20
options.--fx-layer-z: z-index of the spreading circle layer, default 2 — keep images and text above it
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Image to animate (required) — data-frame takes center, left, right and turn
options.[data-fx-part=bubble]: (If present) Speech bubble shown when hitting the wall
options.fx:color: When the background color changes, detail on the panel { index, name }

use: What is it…
note: The original swaps four different PNGs per character (center·left·right·looking back) and pulls a color from the next character’s image for the background — the part only changes the frame name, and colors cycle through a table. On devices without a mouse it only does the shake and bounce.

from.where: index.html .ms-hero__figure — character fixed in the center of the hero
